title.narrative: Support for Infectious Disease Control in Democratic Republic of the Congo

description.narrative: UNOPS manages a Gavi Alliance grant allocated to GRID-3, the preselected implementing partner, who will be producing and updating maps, georeferenced data and population estimates for unvaccinated and under-vaccinated children in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. These activities will be carried out as part of the vaccination Equity Acceleration Funds (EAF) programme in Democratic Republic of the Congo from 2023 to 2025.
